prefix.a1: Sweet Crumb Bakery is launching a new loyalty card, available free at the counter from Monday 3 November. The card gives you one stamp for every purchase of $3 or more, and ten stamps earn you a free loaf or pastry of your choice. Available in blue or green, the card is easy to keep in your wallet and stamps never expire, so you can collect at your own pace. Offices and clubs can place group orders two days ahead to earn double stamps, making it a simple way to save while enjoying your favourites.

You will receive one stamp for every purchase of 3 dollars or more, and ten stamps earn you a free loaf or pastry of your choice. Choose a card in blue or green, collect at your own pace as stamps never expire, and enjoy a little extra with each visit. prefix.b1: Earning and spending with your Sweet Crumb loyalty card is simple. You will receive one stamp for every purchase of $3 or more, and once you have collected ten stamps you can choose a free loaf or pastry of your choice. There is no rush, as stamps never expire, so you can build your collection at your own pace. For larger orders, offices and clubs can arrange group orders two days ahead and earn double stamps on those purchases, helping you reach your reward sooner. Just present your card at the counter each visit to collect your stamp.
prefix.b2: How it works is straightforward. You will receive one stamp on your card for every purchase of $3 or more. Once you have collected ten stamps, you can exchange them for a free loaf or pastry of your choice. There is no hurry to fill your card, as stamps never expire, so you can collect at your own pace. If you pick up your card from Monday 3 November, simply present it at the counter each time you shop to earn your stamps. Choose a blue or green card when you collect it, and use the same card for every visit.
